definitions.explanation: The act of administering a vaccine to a person or animal to build immunity against a disease.

examples.japanese: ⟦ワクチン→ワクチン：05074_wakuchin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{接種|せっしゅ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦インフルエンザ→インフルエンザ：05384_infuruenza⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{予防|よぼう}{接種|せっしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
{三回目|さんかいめ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{接種|せっしゅ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{二回目|にかいめ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{少|すく}なく→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧とも⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧ヶ{月|げつ}⟦{空|あ}けて→空ける：18694_akeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please wait at least three months after the second dose before getting the third vaccination.

notes:
A medical/public health term for vaccination or inoculation. Became extremely common in everyday Japanese during the COVID-19 pandemic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {予防|よぼう}{接種|せっしゅ}: preventive vaccination
- ⟦ワクチン→ワクチン：05074_wakuchin⟧{接種|せっしゅ}: vaccine inoculation
- {接種|せっしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive a vaccination
- {接種|せっしゅ}⟦{券|けん}→券：02150_ken⟧: vaccination voucher/ticket
- {接種|せっしゅ}⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧: vaccination site
- ⟦{追加|ついか}→追加：04060_tsuika⟧{接種|せっしゅ}: booster shot

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{摂取|せっしゅ}→摂取：09322_sesshu⟧: intake, consumption — a homophone with a completely different meaning (taking in food/nutrients)
- ⟦{注射|ちゅうしゃ}→注射：01665_chuusha⟧: injection — a broader term for any injection, not limited to vaccines
- ⟦{予防|よぼう}→予防：03669_yobou⟧: prevention — the general concept; {予防|よぼう}{接種|せっしゅ} specifically means preventive vaccination
